rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for products or services designed for people with a limited budget, such as a budget airline.

example.english: This is a budget airline, ideal for people with limited means.
example.traditional: 呢間係平價航空公司，啱晒預算有限嘅人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 hai6 ping4 gaa3 hong4 hung1 gung1 si1 ngaam1 saai3 jyu6 syun3 jau5 haan6 ge3 jan4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a planned spending amount or an itemized financial plan.

example.english: The budget for this project is five hundred thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 今個項目嘅預算係五十萬蚊。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 jyu6 syun3 hai6 ng5 sap6 maan6 man1

rows.note: Use this when the available budget is small, especially in an “on a budget” context.

example.english: We have only a limited budget for this trip, so we can't stay in expensive hotels.
example.traditional: 我哋今次旅行只得有限嘅預算，唔可以住太貴嘅酒店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 zi2 dak1 jau5 haan6 ge3 jyu6 syun3 m4 ho2 ji5 zyu6 taai3 gwai3 ge3 zau2 dim3
